Stay Updated!

Get notified automatically ? right in Google Chat.

chat Google Chat Notifications

Translation-Services sends you automatic notifications when:

? Your project has been successfully submitted
? Your translation is ready to download
? A colleague shares a project with you
? A project deadline is approaching (24h reminder)
How to activate (3 steps):
1 Open Google Chat and search for the bot "Translation-Services"
2 Click on the bot and send any message (e.g. "Hi") ? this registers your account
3 Click the tune icon here (top right) ? set Notifications to ON ? Save
? When do I receive the first message?
After setting Notifications to ON, you will receive your first message automatically when you submit your first project. No further action needed.
Note: The bot is read-only ? it only sends notifications. It cannot execute commands or answer questions.

chat 1. Initial Setup & Google Chat Notifications

The system can automatically notify you via Google Chat ? as soon as your project is submitted, the translation is ready, or a deadline is approaching.

One-time setup (3 steps):

1
Activate the bot: Open Google Chat, search for the bot "Translation-Services" and send it any message (e.g. "Hello"). This registers your account.
2
Enable notifications: Click the tune icon here (top right) ? set Google Chat Notifications to ON ? Save.
3
Submit your first project: When you submit your first project, you will automatically receive a confirmation message in Google Chat. From then on, you'll be notified whenever a translation is complete.

?? The bot is read-only ? it only sends notifications and does not respond to messages.

message Chat Message Templates
Medium Impact ? Chat Messages

Customize the text of all automated Chat notifications sent by Translation-Services.

  • Use {{PLACEHOLDER}} syntax ? these are replaced dynamically with real values.
  • Click Reset to restore the built-in default for a template.
  • Available placeholders: {{PROJECT_NAME}} {{PHRASE_ID}} {{SOURCE_LANG}} {{TARGET_LANGS}} {{DEADLINE}} {{TEMPLATE_NAME}} {{STATUS}} {{PHRASE_URL}} {{PORTAL_URL}} {{SHARED_BY}} {{UPDATED_BY}} {{NEW_DATE}} {{NOTE_LINE}} {{FILES}}
Click "Reload" to load message templates.
